newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major has ruled out March 20 election-ITN.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major has ruled out March 20 election-ITN.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major has ruled out holding an election on March 20, ITN television said on Thursday.

It quoted Conservative party sources as saying he had ruled out the March date. Major said in an earlier interview that a parliamentary by-election, due to take place on February 27, had to take place first before an election could be held. If there was a March election, the by-election would have to be cancelled. "I think people should just sit back and relax and not get overexcited about it for the moment," Major said. The election must be held by May 22 and May 1 is hot favourite.
